children: Generation Income Properties completed redemption of the remaining $4,160,217 Loci preferred equity, removing the liability from its balance sheet.
Redeemed in full remaining preferred equity held by Loci Capital for $4,160,217, eliminating that liability.
Redemption funded principally with net proceeds from warrant exercise disclosed Sept 21, 2026.
Company says removal of Loci preferred stock simplifies capital structure and materially improves financial position.
Portfolio rent collections and occupancy remain at 100%, per CEO letter to shareholders.
Remaining Nasdaq objective: maintain $1.00 closing bid; reverse split remains an available, but not preferred, option.
